cells.scene: A trusting young adult hands a prized item to an obvious street trickster who hides a fake duplicate behind their back; trusting innocence, no stereotype.
A quality inspector rejects a clearly cracked cup by holding up a stop palm, intact cups beside it.
Three small events converge to delay a traveler: a flat bicycle tire, a fallen branch and a rain cloud; three simple blue arrows meet at a late clock.
A gardener stares astonished at a giant pumpkin taller than the garden fence, hand to mouth, extraordinary yet harmless sight.

prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE SQUARE 2x2 atlas with four equal square cells for an adult vocabulary app. Attached image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: restrained ink-and-watercolor educational illustrations, clear dark blue-charcoal outlines, pale blue wash, small warm natural color accents. Pure WHITE opaque background. Central 75% of each quadrant contains its subject with generous margins. Nothing crosses midlines. Leave horizontal 45–55% and vertical 47–53% center bands EMPTY WHITE. Natural human anatomy, recognizable objects, clear 320px silhouettes, restrained detail, no elaborate environment. NO captions, labels, writing, borders, grid lines, watermarks or logos. Only symbols or numerals explicitly requested in a cell are allowed. Meanings are guidance; never write them. Row-major fixed order. FOUR CELLS:
TOP LEFT — naive (a.天真的): A trusting young adult hands a prized item to an obvious street trickster who hides a fake duplicate behind their back; trusting innocence, no stereotype.
TOP RIGHT — unacceptable (a.不能接受的): A quality inspector rejects a clearly cracked cup by holding up a stop palm, intact cups beside it.
BOTTOM LEFT — conspire (v.(事件)巧合促成): Three small events converge to delay a traveler: a flat bicycle tire, a fallen branch and a rain cloud; three simple blue arrows meet at a late clock.
BOTTOM RIGHT — incredible (a.难以置信的): A gardener stares astonished at a giant pumpkin taller than the garden fence, hand to mouth, extraordinary yet harmless sight.
EXTRA CROP SAFETY: Draw noticeably SMALLER compact subjects. Every object, mast, roof, thought bubble and entire person must have an empty white border of at least 12% of its quadrant on ALL FOUR sides. Top row ends above 44% canvas height; bottom row starts below 58%. Never let a background tower extend upward into the midline. No part is clipped by a quadrant edge.
review_notes: Selected course meanings are represented clearly: deception, rejection, circumstances conspiring, amazement; contempt, familiarization, reunion, and assumption. Anatomy and quadrant crop margins checked.
